subject: [RFC PATCH 1/6] mm/page_alloc: clarify bulk allocator flag scope

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch renames a local variable in the alloc_pages_bulk_noprof function to clarify its scope and purpose. The variable, previously named alloc_flags, is used for fast-path watermark, cpuset, and CMA decisions, which are distinct from the allocator behavior flags stored in the alloc_context. The renaming does not change the functionality of the code, but improves clarity by distinguishing between these two types of flags.
